pageLedePart2: Hosted web trial includes a small Auto Economy cap; higher managed cloud capacity is account-gated while metering, fraud controls, refunds, deletion, and provider terms are proven.
pageLedePart3: The MVP focus is local privacy, explicit BYOK, and a clear path into AGI Cloud.
plansLede: AGI charges nothing for Local or BYOK. Run models on your own hardware or bring your own provider keys on Desktop and CLI. Hosted plans open by waitlist invite as metering, refunds, and provider terms are proven.
localTierBody: Run Ollama or LM Studio offline on your laptop. No keys, no quotas, no internet.
byokTierBody: Bring your own keys to supported cloud providers. Provider billing and data handling are route-specific.
byokFeature3: Visible provider label on every route
hobbyTierBody: Try AGI in the browser with Auto Economy routing. Free hosted usage is intentionally small so the demo stays sustainable.
hobbyFeature4: Upgrade request for higher hosted capacity
managedWaitlistNote: Higher hosted capacity opens through the waitlist below.
waitlistNote: Team hosted capacity opens through account-bound request access.
waitlistBody: Web accounts can already try AGI with a small Auto Economy cap. Leave your details for higher hosted capacity, team plans, and AGI-managed provider compute. Access opens once usage ledgering, abuse controls, retention, and provider-cost controls are enabled for your account.
waitlistTierBody: Request access to be notified when this hosted plan opens for your account.
proTierBody: More planned hosted capacity and routing controls, gated by account access.
maxTierBody: Highest planned hosted capacity and advanced routing, gated by account access.
enterpriseBody: Discuss SSO/SCIM roadmap, audit needs, retention, and custom rollout requirements. Reach out and we will scope it together.
compareSubheading: Local and BYOK run on Desktop and CLI. The web trial is available with a small cap; higher hosted cloud is account-gated.
